member.name: T:PersistentCollection.CollectionTelemetry
member.summary: Process-wide Meter, ActivitySource, and instruments for PersistentCollection. Every recording method is best-effort: it never throws, and it does nothing when no listener is subscribed.

member.name: T:PersistentCollection.PersistentCollectionTelemetry
member.summary: Stable public names for the telemetry emitted by PersistentCollection. The library emits through the BCL System.Diagnostics.Metrics.Meter and System.Diagnostics.ActivitySource APIs only, and takes no dependency on any exporter. When no listener is subscribed, emission is effectively free. A host subscribes by name, for example with Radiant: settings.Sources.AddMeter(PersistentCollectionTelemetry.MeterName) and settings.Sources.AddActivitySource(PersistentCollectionTelemetry.ActivitySourceName), or with the OpenTelemetry SDK: AddMeter(PersistentCollectionTelemetry.MeterName) and AddSource(PersistentCollectionTelemetry.ActivitySourceName). These names, the metric names, and the attribute keys below are public contract. Dashboards and alerts depend on them. This class is thread-safe; it contains only constants.

member.summary: Histogram, unit seconds. Time spent waiting to acquire the per-instance lock before an operation could run. Labels: collection.type, operation.

member.name: F:PersistentCollection.PersistentCollectionTelemetry.PersistenceDuration
member.summary: Histogram, unit seconds. Duration of a disk persistence step (read on open, full rewrite on mutation, truncate on clear). Labels: collection.type, operation (read, write, truncate), outcome, and error.type (only when outcome is error).

member.name: F:PersistentCollection.PersistentCollectionTelemetry.PersistenceSize

member.name: T:PersistentCollection.TelemetryScope
member.summary: Times one collection operation or persistence step, tracks its outcome, and owns its span. Factories return null when nothing is listening, so callers use the null-conditional operator. Every member is best-effort and never throws. Not thread-safe; one scope belongs to one call.
